notes:
Checked on the fake backend only; the device is simulated (mode simulated, R0) and there is no hardware backend, so no hardware run was made. The task card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the upstream environment needs CoppeliaSim v4.1.0 and PyRep (README.md:64) and its Gymnasium ids are registered only by importing rlbench (rlbench/__init__.py:36-48); package code may not import the clone, so the checked backend is the package's kinematic stand-in for RLBenchEnv (fidelity F0). The sim path (gymnasium.make of the registered id) was not run. The fake implements reset, step, render and close plus the action_space and observation_space attributes of RLBenchEnv, and returns the eight upstream state-observation keys with the upstream shapes (7, 7, 7, 1, 7, 2, 6, 3) but synthetic values; it models no physics, contacts, forces, camera or rendering and was never compared with a real RLBench run. NOT COVERED: the rgb frames of the vision observation modes and render() (the fake returns one placeholder pixel), and any dynamics, contact or force behaviour. Warnings left and not cleared: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, seed twice) and the numeric action.values[*] array; these are the expected Gymnasium-family warnings and declaring actions for reset/seed to add units exposes undescribed inputs. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue extension ids were used: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1. The upstream install block in the task card lists no system dependency; README.md:64 requires CoppeliaSim v4.1.0 and PyRep for the upstream environment, recorded in driver.lock.json install.notes. driver.lock.json is model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wD-002) with reviewed_by null; no human reviewed or tested anything.
